title: Weakly contractible colimits of fixed-boundary coherent cocones
statement: Use the universes and smallness of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category] and coherent functor categories, cocones, colimits, cores and homotopy fibers of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\mathcal C$ be a quasicategory, $K$ a small simplicial set, and $p:K\to\mathcal C$ a coherent diagram. Let $I$ be a small weakly contractible quasicategory, meaning that $I\to\Delta^0$ is a weak homotopy equivalence. Assume $\mathcal C$ admits colimits of all $I$-diagrams. Put $Q=\mathcal C_{p/}$ and let $U:Q\to\mathcal C$ be the apex projection. Then $Q$ admits colimits of all $I$-diagrams. For every $F:I\to Q$ and coherent cocone $t$ on $F$, $t$ is colimiting if and only if $U(t)$ is colimiting. The functor induced by $U$ from the space of colimiting cocones on $F$ to the space of colimiting cocones on $UF$ has contractible homotopy fiber over every colimiting cocone on $UF$; thus every specified colimiting apex cocone lifts up to a contractible space of choices, including the equivalence identifying its apex cocone with the specified one. Each space of colimiting cocones is the core of the full subcategory of colimiting objects in the relevant coherent cocone category. No compactness, accessibility or cardinal bound on $I$ or $K$ beyond smallness is assumed, and $K=\varnothing$ is allowed.
